changeSet.neo4j:cypher: MATCH (n0:term {value:'ABI Solid',origin_id:'6298102',origin_version:'1',origin_definition:'A proprietary next-generation DNA sequencing system from Applied Biosystems that utilizes DNA ligase. changeSet.neo4j:cypher: MATCH (n0:term {value:'Fanconi Anemia',origin_id:'5651022',origin_version:'1',origin_definition:'A rare inherited disorder in which the bone marrow does not make blood cells.
